name: list_signal_templates
description:
List Recon's signal templates: ready-to-run searches, each built around one buying trigger.

    product: optional product line the seller sells, one of firewall, email, endpoint, vuln, asm,
    mdr, ot. Templates built for that product are marked for_you. Use the template id with
    search_accounts.

name: search_accounts
description:
Find and rank companies that need security help now, from internet scan evidence.

    template: a signal template id from list_signal_templates, or "market" for every account.
    query: part of a company or organisation name. country: ISO-2 code (US, GB, DE...).
    industry: e.g. "Financial services", "Healthcare", "Manufacturing", "Education".
    sector: commercial, public (public sector and education) or infra (telecom and hosting).
    software: a product family seen on their services, e.g. "Fortinet FortiGate", "Microsoft Exchange",
    "Citrix NetScaler", "Microsoft SQL Server". strong_identity: only accounts whose company name
    comes from their own TLS certificate or domain. tier: P1 (top 500), P2 or P3.
    Results are ranked by priority, highest first.

name: get_account
description:
Everything Recon knows about one account: score breakdown, why now, and the evidence by signal
    (IP addresses masked to /24). Use the id returned by search_accounts or cve_exposure.

name: cve_exposure
description:
Which companies run software affected by a vulnerability in the news.

    cve_or_name: a CVE id (CVE-2023-4966) or a well-known name (Citrix Bleed, ProxyShell, Log4Shell).
    Returns the CVE's facts (CVSS, EPSS, CISA KEV status and ransomware use) and the affected accounts
    ranked by priority. A CVE not matched in the scan falls back to companies running the affected product.

name: make_list
description:
Turn accounts into a list the seller can work in Recon. Returns a link: opening it adds the
    accounts to My list in the app (to contact, contacted, meeting booked, not a fit).

name: export_crm_tasks
description:
CRM-ready call tasks for accounts, one per row (company, subject, note, priority, link), as CSV
    text to import into HubSpot or Salesforce. Subjects and notes are filled from the evidence.
